text:
Aisha Khan: Hey team — excited to join! Quick access question: my Okta invite shows as `Accepted` but I get a 403 when I try to open Google Drive. Also 1Password invite link expired. Who should I ping to get both re-provisioned?

Marc L: welcome Aisha :tada: Ping @Celeste (IT) for Okta reprovisioning. For 1Password, tag Jamie from People Ops or reply here and I can escalate.

Aisha Khan: thanks Marc. tagging Celeste now — @Celeste (IT) can you double-check my org unit? My email is aisha.k@redwood.dev and looks like there's an alias conflict when I try to access shared folders.

Celeste (IT): hi Aisha, welcome! I see an Okta session for aisha.k@redwood.dev but the Drive permission error usually means the Google account created doesn't have the GSuite group mapping. Can you paste the exact error you see?

Aisha Khan: it just shows "You don't have access to this item" and a link. When I click the link it opens to accounts.google.com with the wrong account selected. Sometimes Google prompts to choose a different account but selecting mine keeps redirecting.

Celeste (IT): got it. Two quick checks: 1) are you signed into a personal Google account in the browser? try an incognito window. 2) run `gcloud auth list` if you have gcloud (not required though). I'll re-send a fresh Okta push and check the group sync.

Aisha Khan: tried incognito — same redirect. No gcloud installed on this machine yet. Also, my 1Password seat email says "invitation expired" when I click the link that was sent yesterday.

Jamie (People Ops): hey Aisha — sorry about the expired invite, we had a batch that hit the expiry window. I'll trigger a new seat invite right now. Expect an email in ~5 minutes. If you don't see it, check spam and then tell me which email it should go to (confirm if it's aisha.k@redwood.dev).

IT Support Bot: New ticket created: #INC-2048 — Subject: "New hire Aisha: Okta->GDrive access + 1Password invite". Assigned to Celeste (IT), priority: P2. Estimated first response < 30m.

Celeste (IT): thanks Jamie, I'll link the 1Password seat once People Ops confirms. Aisha — I looked at the Google directory and your account is in the right OU but seems to have two aliases: `aisha.k@redwood.dev` and `a.khan@redwood.dev`. That can confuse Drive links that are shared to the alias. I'm going to consolidate aliases and force a group sync. I'll post here when complete.

Riley S: also pinging Oncall-DevOps — if the sharing link was created with a different alias we might need to update the Drive ACL or re-share after alias consolidation.

Oncall-DevOps: noted, will stand by. If Celeste confirms alias consolidation, we'll run a propagation job. ETA ~15m after confirmation.

Aisha Khan: appreciate everyone! one tiny extra Q: who do I DM about getting repo access? I opened the welcome docs but I'm not sure who is the default reviewer to add to teams.

Marc L: ping me or Riley, we handle infra repos. I'll add you to the "platform-engineering" team once Celeste confirms your email match.

Celeste (IT): Ok — alias consolidation started. Jamie confirmed 1Password invite sent to aisha.k@redwood.dev. IT ticket #INC-2048 updated. I'll reply here when Drive access is validated.

Aisha Khan: got the 1Password invite and set up MFA. Okta push also came through and I completed device trust. Trying Drive now... access looks good  :grin: Thanks everyone!

Marc L: :rocket: welcome aboard Aisha. If anything else blocks you in the first week, drop a note here or DM me.

Aisha Khan: will do, thanks all!
